card.name: Unit mg in dose step increases
card.fires_on: The unit 'mg' right after a number that gives the size of a dose increase, as in 'increase by 500 mg' or 'increments of 25 mg'. It appears in titration instructions that mention weekly or periodic steps.

modes.label: Increase by amount
modes.description: mg after a number following 'increase by' or 'raised by'.
modes.example: the dose of metformin should be increased by 500 mg after approximately one week and by 500<< mg>> every week thereafter

modes.label: Increments of amount
modes.description: mg after a number following 'in increments of'.
modes.example: daily dosage may be raised in increments of 2.5<< mg>> at weekly intervals until optimal response is obtained
